principal_rules: The three exact-source reviewers have pairwise byte-distinct orchestrator agent IDs.
Every exact-source reviewer differs from every excluded reviewer principal.
Reviewers may inspect only the exact bound regular Git blobs and metadata.
A reviewer must return REVISE for any nonempty finding.

rules: id, role, and retained path equal the exact role mappings
review_target_manifest_sha256 equals the retained V15 target digest
review_authorization_sha256 equals this retained authorization digest
protected_source_sha256 and test_source_sha256 equal the target manifest
findings is the exact empty JSON array

review_requirements: The test source is derived from V6/V7 semantics and contains independent reference arithmetic rather than copied or normalized-equivalent protected implementation bodies.
The test source uses only the Python standard library and the exact bound public pure-core module surface.

Public positive assertions cover the chart fixture, all 18 indexed witnesses, exactly three vertical omissions, aggregate 6 tangent, 12 secant, and 3 vertical counters, fibers, representatives, diagnostics, and every successful CoreOps field.
Public negative assertions cover every reachable domain error, first-error precedence, exact indices, and charged failure prefixes.

NONINVERTIBLE_DENOMINATOR, INTERCEPT_MISMATCH, and INTERNAL_INVARIANT_FAILURE are static invariant proof obligations and are not exercised with private access, mutation, monkeypatching, or fault injection.
Mutation-oriented public assertions cover chart-scalar congruence, source-label sorting, vertical-pair omission, least-slope selection, and immutability without mutating implementation state.

The test source contains no registered seed, filesystem input or output, randomness, clock, environment dependency, network, subprocess, CLI, serializer, campaign wrapper, evidence writer, experiment runner, or cryptanalytic claim.
The module text contains no import-time call that would execute the pure core or tests merely by importing the test module.
Any ambiguity, missing coverage, source-copying concern, or apparent defect is a finding and requires REVISE.
test_source_exact_review_authorization.transition_rule: Three conforming exact-source V15 GO receipts are advisory only. A separate exact Coordinator decision is required before any parser, import, compiler, analyzer, or test execution.
